Definition: a reservoir; by analogy, a marsh
BiblicalUsage: gebeʼ means cistern, pool. It turns up twice, in Isaiah and Ezekiel.
TheologicalSignificance: I read gebeʼ plainly: cistern, pool, and I leave it there.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
